title: Vice Salt Nic E-Liquid – Cherry Watermelon Ice 30ml
description:
Description
Dive into a mouthwatering oasis of flavour with Cherry Watermelon Ice by Vice Salt, where juicy cherries and refreshing watermelons are kissed by an arctic breeze, creating a vaping sensation like no other!
Crafted with care, Vice Salt ensures that every puff delivers a smooth and satisfying throat hit. The high-quality ingredients and expert formulation guarantee a consistent and enjoyable vaping experience. Embrace a delightful adventure of flavours with Vice Salt, a must-try for both fruit and menthol enthusiasts alike!
Flavour Notes:
Cherry
Watermelon
Ice
Vice Salt E-Liquid is NOT intended for use in Sub-Ohm Tank systems. Vice E-Liquid is intended for small pod systems.
50% VG 50% PG
